title: A clear limit brings quiet courage

captions.physics: Ending an unsupported form of understanding
captions.energy: Revealing a shared explanation’s weak foundation

meaning: Revealing weak foundations and ending an unsupported explanation can help your shared view bear change calmly.
text: Courage can appear through a precisely named ending. The Tower in the energy position of Ajna helps reveal a shared explanation’s weak foundation. Death in the physical position ends an unsupported form of understanding. Strength in emotions feels gentle confidence before change. Your view can remain with material without demanding immediate restoration of the former picture’s simplicity, allowing a gap to become visible without making it a judgement of either person’s ability.

For example, you examine photographs showing a paper model being assembled. You previously explained each transition through one obvious fold. You notice actions missing between images. **Clearly ending a version lets you remain courageously with an open question.** You stop treating the whole sequence as already reconstructed. Visible paper positions remain while a transition becomes unknown. Your view grows more precise. You can calmly recognise this limit and consider available relationships without calling the gap an inability to understand or inventing a compulsory step for readiness.

The risk is treating quiet confidence as a need to fill every omission yourself immediately. A fresh guess gains knowledge’s status again. Revealing weak foundations preserves the distinction. Positions are visible in photographs while the transition remains unestablished. Understanding bears change when gentle courage supports precise consideration and an ended version may stay ended without urgent replacement by an equally complete picture.
